_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 14:22 ET AND NOT CARRIED FORWARD: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, so the whole balance is settled and no good-faith violation is reachable - unchanged from the 10:23, 11:23, 12:23 and 13:22 reads because nothing has traded. Equity and option position lists were BOTH queried live at 14:22 and BOTH ARE EMPTY, so no exit of any kind is due: no target, no stop, no time stop and no option no-fly window exists to be reached this hour. ZERO equity orders and ZERO option orders exist with a created_at floor of 2026-08-19, so agentTrades stays 0 and the 33.87 level remains unowned. THE FINDING OF THIS HOUR IS THAT THE ACCELERATION STOPPED WITHOUT THE DISTANCE CLOSING. AS is 34.61 bid / 34.62 ask at 18:22:53.232Z on a 0.029% spread, the tightest quote it has printed today, last trade 34.615, +2.94% on the bid against the 33.62 settled close. The 33.87 limit is 0.74 below the bid against 0.71 an hour ago: the gap series across five hourly reads is 0.26, 0.28, 0.36, 0.71, 0.74, so this hour added 0.03 after last hour added 0.35. The drift decelerated by an order of magnitude and the level is still further away than it has ever been - both halves are true and the second one is the one that matters. The lowest five-minute low between 13:20 and 14:20 ET is 34.49, a full 0.62 above the limit, so a resting order was unfillable for a THIRD consecutive hour, and AS set a fresh 34.83 session high in the 14:00 ET bar. The specification is RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED for a fifth consecutive hour and THE LIMIT IS NOT RAISED for a ninth time. Both written invalidations are untouched: the 33.70 early warning is the session low EXACTLY, set in the opening five minutes and unrevisited in eight and a half hours of tape, and the 33.41 outright void is 1.20 below the bid and untestable before the bell. Its 372.57 cost is 36.9% of the account, inside the 40% single-name ceiling, and it is the only claim on the cash. THE LAST-HOUR NOTIFICATION OWED BY THIS SLOT WAS SENT: 15:30 is 67 minutes away and the next hourly fires at 15:17, thirteen minutes before expiry, so this is the run that owes it. Fired 14:21 against the 14:17 slot, four minutes late and sixteen minutes inside the 20-minute guard. The scope preflight matched the mandate identifier EXACTLY; every other account was discarded unread. The clock was cross-checked against the broker rather than trusted: venue_bid_time reads 18:22:53.232Z against a local 14:22 ET, confirming the -4 EDT offset.

entryWatch.setup: AS post-earnings DAY-2 continuation - the 100% EPS beat of 8/18, whose gap faded and whose close held, specified today at a 33.87 limit for 11 shares
entryWatch.trigger: ARMED, RE-QUOTED AT 14:22 AND CONFIRMED FOR A FIFTH HOUR - AND THE DRIFT AWAY FROM THE LIMIT ALL BUT STOPPED WITHOUT ANY OF THE DISTANCE COMING BACK. AS is 34.61 bid / 34.62 ask at 18:22:53.232Z on a 0.029% spread - one cent wide, the tightest this name has quoted today - last trade 34.615, +2.94% on the bid against the 33.62 settled close, with a fresh 34.83 session high set in the 14:00 ET bar. THE 33.87 LIMIT IS UNFILLED AND NOW SITS 0.74 BELOW THE BID, AGAINST 0.71 AN HOUR AGO. The gap series across five hourly reads is 0.26, 0.28, 0.36, 0.71, 0.74: this hour widened it by 0.03 after last hour widened it by 0.35, so the sharp acceleration the 13:21 run reported did NOT continue. That is the honest correction to last hour's emphasis, and it does not change the position: 0.74 is still the widest the gap has been, and the limit is 2.14% under the bid. The lowest five-minute low between 13:20 and 14:20 ET is 34.49, 0.62 above the limit, so this is the THIRD consecutive hour in which a resting order could not have filled at any tick, and the forty-minute morning window in which it would have filled closed three and a half hours ago. Filling before the 15:30 expiry now requires a 2.14% reversal in sixty-seven minutes. IT IS STILL NOT RAISED. This is the ninth direction the same refusal has been tested in. BOTH INVALIDATIONS WRITTEN BEFORE THE OUTCOME REMAIN UNTRIGGERED. The early warning is a trade below 33.70; that is the session low EXACTLY, set in the opening five minutes and untouched in eight and a half hours of tape. The outright void is a close below 33.41, now 1.20 below the bid. THE LAST-HOUR NOTIFICATION IS DISCHARGED BY THIS RUN, as the 12:22 and 13:21 rows both predicted it would be: 15:30 is sixty-seven minutes out and the 15:17 hourly would reach it with thirteen minutes left, which is not a warning.
entryWatch.why: CONFIRMED FOR A FIFTH HOUR, AND THE KILL TEST STILL TURNS ON LIMB THREE, WHICH STILL COMES OUT ON THE CONFIRM SIDE. Limb one, the invalidation, is untriggered and 1.20 from the void. Limb two, the limit no longer inside the spread, is met on a literal reading and rejected on the same narrow one the 10:21, 11:22, 12:22 and 13:21 runs wrote down: a buy limit the tape has risen ABOVE is a resting bid rather than a dead level, and this morning proved that reading by filling-distance when the name came back through it for forty minutes. LIMB THREE ASKS WHETHER THE SETUP THE ENTRY DESCRIBED IS STILL THE SETUP ON THE TAPE, AND IT IS MORE TRUE THAN WHEN IT WAS WRITTEN. The setup was a day-2 post-earnings continuation off a 100% EPS beat, entered on a pullback, with a higher low at 33.70 as its written support. 33.70 has held all session as the exact low and the name has just made another new session high at 34.83. What has left the tape is the ENTRY PRICE, not the SETUP. Killing a specification because the thesis worked without the board owning it is the exact mirror of raising the limit because the thesis worked without the board owning it. THE ONE THING THAT CHANGED THIS HOUR CUTS AGAINST LAST HOUR'S FRAMING AND IS RECORDED AS SUCH. The 13:21 run's headline was that the drift accelerated - 0.35 in one hour, more than the previous three combined - and the implication a reader would take from it is that the level was running away at an increasing rate. It was not. The next hour added 0.03. One hour is not a trend, which is exactly the reason the deceleration is reported as plainly as the acceleration was rather than left out because it is less dramatic. WHAT DID NOT CHANGE IS THE ARITHMETIC OF THE REMAINING TIME. Sixty-seven minutes and a required 2.14% reversal is a worse proposition than two hours and 2.05% was, so the specification is confirmed, valid, and less likely to fill than at any prior read. The operator relying on this row should know the level is live and probably out of reach, not merely that it is live. THE UNCOMFORTABLE HALF IS UNCHANGED AND GREW AGAIN. This is the fifth consecutive published specification nobody executed, the first whose level printed while it was live and re-validated, and the board has now spent five hours re-validating an entry it correctly identified, correctly struck, and does not own. Filled at 33.87 the 372.57 would read 380.71: up 8.14 or 2.19%, against 2.10% an hour ago. The 8.14 is not the point. The point is that the process worked and the delivery did not, and this run sent the notification the rulebook owes rather than adding a sixth hour of silent re-validation.

entryWatch.setup: TGT post-print gap-down reversal to a 52-week high - ranked second today, refused on item 2, and named in advance as tomorrow's better day-2 candidate if it holds
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 14:22 AND HIGHER AGAIN, EXTENDING THE FOURTH SWING RATHER THAN REVERSING IT. TGT is 161.41 bid / 161.51 ask at 18:22:49.087Z, last 161.52, +5.86% against the 152.48 close - up another 0.21 on the bid in this hour and now 0.96 ABOVE the 160.45 the open refused it at. Across five hourly reads the item-2 refusal has been paid, then regretted, then roughly flat, then regretted, and now regretted by slightly more. That sequence, not any single read in it, is the actual evidence about buying a day-1 high. THE WRITTEN TEST FOR TOMORROW IS UNCHANGED AND IS NOT SOFTENED BY A GREEN AFTERNOON: a day-2 hold above today's close on lighter volume, with an entry struck after the fade rather than at the high. Where today's close lands is still the input that test needs and it still does not exist - it is ninety-eight minutes away.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD BECAUSE IT IS THE STRONGEST THING THIS RUN REFUSED, AND THIS HOUR IS THE MOST EXPENSIVE THAT REFUSAL HAS LOOKED. Item 2 refuses buying 9.7% off a session low at a fresh high on day 1; TGT has since made a higher high again and the entry declined at 160.45 would now be up 0.47%. The rule is not amended for one session, because item 2 is not a prediction that the day-1 high fails - it is a statement that this board does not have an edge buying it, and a rule that survives only while it is winning is not a rule. AS and TGT still differ on exactly one axis, day 2 versus day 1, and today is turning into a clean paired test of that preference: the day-2 name was specified and not owned, and the day-1 name was refused and would have paid. Holding both visible is what lets the retro grade the preference honestly instead of grading the one that happened to be written down.

entryWatch.setup: SMCI post-print pullback - the twice-forced thesis this board specified on 8/17 and did not fill, refused for a twelfth time
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD ON A SEVENTEENTH TEST AND LOWER AGAIN, WHICH STILL CHANGES NOTHING IN EITHER DIRECTION. SMCI is 36.88 bid / 36.89 ask at 18:22:52.839Z, a 0.027% spread and again the tightest quote on the board, -1.42% against the 37.41 close and DOWN 0.29 from the 37.17 read at 13:22. The 36.89 ask is 1.35 below the 38.24 limit that expired unfilled on 8/17 - still a better fill than that order asked for, and still not revived. Had seven shares filled at 38.24 for 267.68 they would read 258.16, -9.52 or -3.56%, the worst mark of the series so far.
entryWatch.why: NOT REVIVED, AND THE REASON IS UNCHANGED RATHER THAN NEWLY CONVENIENT. That entry was forced on items 1 and 5: no catalyst, with the 8/11 print now six sessions back, and its own written buy condition unmet. Neither is repaired by the price falling - a cheaper entry into a thesis with no catalyst is a cheaper entry into a thesis with no catalyst. SMCI appears nowhere in the live 8/19-to-8/26 calendar re-pulled this run. It keeps its place for liquidity alone, which is still the best here, and it is passed over for a name whose item 1 passes outright.

entryWatch.setup: KLAR post-print collapse - a beat that lost a fifth of the company, now on day 2 with still no base
entryWatch.trigger: UNCHANGED ON THE HOUR AND STILL NOT A SETUP, WHICH IS THE SAME ANSWER FOR THE SAME REASON. KLAR is 14.65 bid / 14.66 ask at 18:22:53.334Z, -2.72% against the 15.06 close and identical to the 14.65 read at 13:22, so a second consecutive down day is grinding sideways rather than basing. The precondition any entry here would need is a level struck AFTER the gap that holds on lighter volume with a written invalidation, and a flat hour inside a red day supplies none of it. The day-2 argument that confirms AS still does not transfer to a name whose day 1 was -22.5%.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD AS THE LIVE COUNTEREXAMPLE THAT STOPS ITEM 1 DECAYING INTO A NUMBER CAME OUT, AND ON DAY 2 IT IS DOING THAT JOB BETTER THAN IT DID ON DAY 1. AS and KLAR both beat on 8/18. AS is +0.6% today after closing +3.2%; KLAR is -2.9% today after closing -22.5%. Two beats, two sessions, opposite outcomes - which is the whole argument for requiring that a catalyst be read together with positioning rather than counted on its own.

candidatesNote: The twelve carried-forward rows are bids from ONE quote call at 13:42:5x UTC and the six names added today are from a second call at 13:43:1x-13:43:2x UTC, so each row is a real timestamped bid rather than a blend. AS and TGT were RE-QUOTED at 13:46:2x when the limit was struck and both numbers are given on those rows. The field was widened rather than the bar lowered: eleven names reported between 8/18 and this morning and all of them are priced here, including the three beats the tape sold, which are the evidence item 5 passed on.

candidates.note: 34.06 bid at 13:42:55Z and RE-QUOTED 33.82 bid / 33.87 ask at 13:46:21Z, +0.60% against the 33.62 close - THE NAME SPECIFIED TODAY at a 33.87 limit for 11 shares, the second consecutive not-forced entry. Its 9/18 32.5 call cleared EVERY option gate at 13:45:01Z on a 1.94% spread with 0.672 delta and 7,857 OI, then quoted 9.71% at 13:46:23Z - refused on that instability, which is why the instrument is equity.

148.73 bid, -1.40% on a 1.22 against 1.19 BEAT. One of three names today that beat and sold off, and part of the live evidence item 5 passed on for AS: crowded expectations mean a merely-good report sells off. Not bought - buying the down half of a print is not a setup here.

332.36 bid, -2.53% on a 3.07 against 2.42 beat - a 27% beat sold off the next morning, the sharpest of today's three and the cleanest single illustration of item 5 on the board. Not bought.

36.75 bid, -1.76%, and 1.49 BELOW the 38.24 limit that expired unfilled on 8/17. Twelfth test, still marketable, still not revived: a lower price does not supply the catalyst item 1 wanted, the 8/11 print is six sessions back, and SMCI is absent from the live 8/19-8/26 calendar. Best liquidity on the board at a 0.05% spread.

14.62 bid, -2.92%, a second consecutive down day after an EPS beat of 0.01 against -0.06. No base has formed, which is the precondition any entry here would need. Kept as the counterexample to today's own thesis: two 8/18 beats, and on day 2 one is +0.6% and the other is -2.9% on top of -22.5%.

160.64 bid, +4.91% on a 1.57 against 1.44 beat after yesterday's close. Ranked third. Refused on the same item 2 ground as TGT: an after-hours print reacting the next morning is effectively day 1, and this is the first session's move.

92.83 bid, +2.16% - bouncing after an 8.66% drop on a 1.06 against 1.35 EPS MISS. A dated catalyst that resolved against the name, and a day-2 bounce off a miss is not the day-2 continuation this rulebook buys. The setup requires the print to have been GOOD.

29.97 bid, +2.95%, back at the 30.20/30.32 shelf whose loss this board wrote as the invalidation in advance - reclaimed from below rather than defended. Eleven sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead, so item 1 refuses it regardless of the level. The expired 30.59 limit stays dead.

76.09 bid, +2.18% on a 2.31 against 2.04 beat this morning. A real beat with a modest reaction, which is the least objectionable of today's fresh prints after TGT. Passed over for AS on the day-1 versus day-2 axis alone, and noted so the ranking is legible.
43.16 bid, -2.18%. Ten sessions past its print with nothing dated ahead and no second argument in the catalyst's place. Item 1 refuses it.

40.82 bid, -1.31%. Nothing dated ahead. Named in the 8/10 rule as one of the four that led hardest and unwound hardest.
8.65 bid, +0.12%. Nothing dated ahead, and the name this account closed at -14.0% on 8/6. Same complex as OKLO, so two of them would be the concentration limit rather than diversification.

27.25 bid, -4.35% on a 0.64 against 1.08 EPS MISS, the largest miss on today's calendar. Priced here so the morning's field is recorded whole rather than only its green half. Not a candidate.
